content_sections.heading: About BRIC-RGCB
content_sections.text: BRIC-Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology is a research centre at Thycaud Post, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. This position is in the laboratory of Dr. Karthika Rajeeve, Scientist E I, and is funded by a DBT project titled "Human Brain Organoids in space as a transformative model to understand Neurodegeneration".

content_sections.heading: BRIC-RGCB Research Associate-I Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Nationality: Only Indian citizens can apply. Age limit: 40 years as on 16 November 2026. Age relaxation is given as per Govt. of India norms. Essential qualification: Ph.D. in Biotechnology. Desirable (preferred, not mandatory): Research experience in human cell culture, molecular and cellular biology, disease-relevant in vitro models, 3D culture and organoid biology Exposure to stem cell/iPSC-based models, bioengineering approaches and advanced imaging Proficiency in experimental design, quantitative data analysis, scientific writing and manuscript preparation Interdisciplinary research experience At least one first-author peer-reviewed publication For the full eligibility of this post, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applicants who meet the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted for an online selection interview. The final selection will be based on qualifications and performance in that interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is initially for two years or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. Like all project positions at RGCB, this post is co-terminus with the end of the project. Selection does not entitle the candidate to any future position at RGCB, permanent or otherwise.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BRIC-RGCB Research Associate-I Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the official notification for Adv. 20/2026 and use its Apply Online option. Fill in the application in the prescribed format. Applications in any other format will be rejected without further consideration. Candidates now working in Government firms must send their application through proper channel. Anyone applying for more than one position must submit a separate application form for each. Submit the completed application by 16 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Contact
content_sections.text: BRIC-Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology, Thycaud Post, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram - 695 014, Kerala, India. Phone: +91-471-2529400 | 2347975 | 2348753. Email: [email protected] , [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. What qualification is needed for the BRIC-RGCB Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Ph.D. in Biotechnology. Experience in organoid biology, iPSC-based models and at least one first-author peer-reviewed publication are desirable.

faq.question: Q2. Which project is the post under?
faq.answer: It is under the DBT project "Human Brain Organoids in space as a transformative model to understand Neurodegeneration", in Dr. Karthika Rajeeve's laboratory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly pay?
faq.answer: The post pays ₹ 58,000/- a month plus 18% HRA.

faq.question: Q4. Is there age relaxation?
faq.answer: Yes. The age limit is 40 years as on 16 November 2026, with relaxation as per Govt. of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. Will the interview be held in person?
faq.answer: No. Shortlisted candidates are called for an online selection interview.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: It is initially for two years or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. The post is co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q7. I work in a Government firm. How do I apply?
faq.answer: You must send your application through proper channel.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job located?
